title: Polokwane (approx.): water outage while Pump Station 3 is stopped to repair two pipeline leaks, outside PS2 and at Ga-Maja, about 8 Oct
summary: Polokwane Municipality told residents of a water outage after Lepelle Northern Water stopped Pump Station 3 for urgent repairs to two pipeline leaks, one just outside Pump Station 2 and one at Ga-Maja (municipal notice, ...
story: Polokwane Municipality told residents of a water outage after Lepelle Northern Water stopped Pump Station 3 for urgent repairs to two pipeline leaks, one just outside Pump Station 2 and one at Ga-Maja (municipal notice, published by Review Online on 8 October). The repairs were estimated at about eight hours. Affected areas listed include Ga-Chuene, Thokgweng, Polokwane City, Seshego, Nirvana, Bendor, Penina Park and Westenburg, several extensions, Peter Mokaba Stadium and the line to Krugersburg. The date the pump station was stopped is not stated, so the date is the report date. One report, resting on the municipality. The pin is approximate: the Polokwane town point stands for the affected area, not for either leak; Ga-Maja lies about 28 km south of the pin.
incident: About Thu 8 Oct 2026: the notice was published that morning; the day the pump station was stopped is not stated (Polokwane Municipality, via Review Online). Repairs estimated at about eight hours.
reported: 8 Oct 2026 (Review Online, municipal notice); earliest report found
location_note: Two leaks on the bulk line, one just outside Pump Station 2 and one at Ga-Maja; the outage covered parts of Polokwane (Polokwane Municipality, via Review Online). The pin is the Polokwane town point from the place-name list and stands for the affected area. Neither leak is pinned: Pump Station 2 could not be placed, and Ga-Maja is about 28 km south. Approximate, town level (about 15 km).
